_instructions: Copy this file, rename to [UtilityShortName].json, and fill in all fields. Every field must have a real value before the utility can be modelled. See CLAUDE.md for guidance on where to find each value.
name: Full legal utility name
short_name: Display name used in charts and tables
filing_case: Most recent rate case docket number and status
capacity_market: NYISO | PJM | MISO | CAISO | SPP | ERCOT | Vertically integrated
capacity_market_zone: Load zone name within the market
rate_base_start_m: NUMERIC — approved electric rate base in $M at start of projection (source: rate case order)
annual_capex_m: NUMERIC — approved annual electric CAPEX in $M (source: rate case capital budget)
total_revenue_m: NUMERIC — total electric revenue requirement in $M including all riders and adjustment clauses
roe: NUMERIC — allowed ROE as decimal e.g. 0.094 (source: rate case order)
equity_ratio: NUMERIC — equity share of capital structure as decimal e.g. 0.48
peak_demand_mw: NUMERIC — summer peak demand in MW
annual_energy_gwh: NUMERIC — annual electric energy sales in GWh
residential_kwh_month: INTEGER — benchmark customer monthly usage for bill calculations. 600 for NY PSC standard; 1000 for Virginia SCC standard
delivery_rate_kwh: NUMERIC — residential delivery rate in $/kWh (source: residential tariff schedule)
supply_rate_kwh: NUMERIC — residential supply/energy rate in $/kWh. Use 0 if vertically integrated and supply not separately stated
basic_charge_month: NUMERIC — residential fixed monthly customer charge in $
delivery_share_rr: NUMERIC — delivery charges as share of total revenue requirement, as decimal
dc_load_growth_annual: NUMERIC — legacy field, superseded by dc_load_mw_start + dc_load_growth_rate below. NOT a true fallback: if dc_load_mw_start is omitted (defaults to 0), the data-centre segment contributes zero load growth regardless of this value, because dc_load_mw_start=0 zeroes out the segment entirely rather than reproducing the old blended-rate behaviour. New utilities must set dc_load_mw_start and dc_load_growth_rate — do not rely on this field alone.
dc_load_mw_start: NUMERIC — data centre load in MW at start of projection (2026). Used with dc_load_growth_rate to model data centre load as a separate segment growing from its own base. Set to 0 if data centre load is negligible.
dc_load_growth_rate: NUMERIC — annual growth rate of the data centre load segment only, applied to dc_load_mw_start not to total load. Typical range 0.05-0.15. Higher than dc_load_growth_annual for the same scenario because it applies to a smaller base.
dc_distribution_share: NUMERIC — share of new data centre load at distribution voltage
dc_flexibility_share: NUMERIC — share of data centre load enrollable in demand response
der_storage_mw_start: NUMERIC — installed distributed storage at start of projection in MW
ev_managed_charging_pct_bau: NUMERIC — share of EVs in managed charging programmes under BAU
property_tax_rate: NUMERIC — effective property tax rate on electric rate base as decimal e.g. 0.016
nws_eligible_capex_share_start: NUMERIC — share of CAPEX programme addressable by NWS at programme start. Range 0.15-0.50
dist_upgrade_cost_per_mw: NUMERIC — blended cost per MW of NWS-eligible distribution upgrade in $M. See CLAUDE.md for derivation guidance
_notes: Add any jurisdiction-specific notes here — regulatory framework, pending cases, known data limitations, parameter derivation sources
_milestone_note: Define state-specific policy milestone years in Section 1 of the notebook using the MY dict — do NOT copy New York CLCPA years to other states. For Virginia use VCEA milestones. For other states find the relevant clean energy legislation and its key target years.
